packageRules.description: This repository is the source of the @adea-ai/themes package: never self-update an internal package.
GitHub Actions version bumps ride one grouped draft PR per cycle instead of one PR per action.

External dependency updates (majors included) ride ONE draft branch per cycle. No auto-merge: GitHub refuses to attach it to a draft PR, and every PR must open as a draft because the code-foundry gates only run on the ready-for-review transition — a human marks each batch ready and merges it once the gates pass.
